dogecoin.text:
When #Bitcoin rises so is #Dogecoin. 

Once BTC hits $100k+ USD, most faucets are either shutting down or getting worthless.

Despite the more usage of Kin apps in mobile devices, Kin is nowhere close to being worth earning. RIP #Kin. Same goes to #PiCoin.

1 #Dogecoin at $0.13 USD needs to do better on its worth.

Despite DOGE in the top 10 popular crypto recently, it still needs to catch up to #Ripple, #Cardano and #Tether.
Why would anyone predict #DogeDay420 will be the day Dogecoin will make history once again? While Bitcoin is down a bit, Doge is slowly creeping up once again.
